name: password-input
title: Password Input
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: A password field with a show/hide toggle, built on `InputGroup`. The toggle is a button named by `toggleLabel` (default "Show password"; pass a translation as needed) whose `aria-pressed` reports whether the text is revealed; visibility is uncontrolled (`defaultRevealed`) or controlled (`isRevealed`/`onRevealedChange`). The rest of the props go to the input, so it works inside a react-aria `TextField` (label, description, validation) and takes `autoComplete="current-password"` or `"new-password"`. Hides Edge's built-in reveal button. Pair with `password-rules` when creating a password.
